mn105:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
mn105:2.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulehi bhikkhūhi bhagavato santike aññā byākatā hoti
mn105:2.2: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmā’ti.
mn105:2.4: ‘sambahulehi kira bhikkhūhi bhagavato santike aññā byākatā hoti
mn105:2.5: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāmā’ti.
mn105:3.1: atha kho sunakkhatto licchaviputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sunakkhatto licchaviputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn105:4.2: sambahulehi kira bhikkhūhi bhagavato santike aññā byākatā
mn105:4.3: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāmā’ti.
mn105:4.4: ye te bhante, bhikkhū bhagavato santike aññaṃ byākaṃsu
mn105:4.5: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāmā’ti. kacci te bhante, bhikkhū sammadeva aññaṃ byākaṃsu udāhu santetthekacce bhikkhū adhimānena aññaṃ byākaṃsū’ti?
mn105:5.1: ye te sunakkhatta, bhikkhū mama santike aññaṃ byākaṃsu
mn105:5.2: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāmā’ti.
mn105:5.3: santetthekacce bhikkhū sammadeva aññaṃ byākaṃsu, santi panidhekacce bhikkhū adhimānenapi aññaṃ byākaṃsu.
mn105:5.4: tatra, sunakkhatta, ye te bhikkhū sammadeva aññaṃ byākaṃsu tesaṃ taṃ tatheva hoti.
mn105:5.5: ye pana te bhikkhū adhimānena aññaṃ byākaṃsu, tatra sunakkhatta, tathāgatassa evaṃ hoti:
mn105:5.9: atha ca panidhekacce moghapurisā pañhaṃ abhisaṅkharitvā abhisaṅkharitvā tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchanti.
mn105:5.10: tatra sunakkhatta, yampi tathāgatassa evaṃ hoti:
mn105:6.1: etassa bhagavā kālo, etassa sugata kālo.
mn105:6.2: ‘yaṃ bhagavā dhammaṃ deseyya. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī’ti.
mn105:6.3: tena hi sunakkhatta, suṇohi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi bhāsissāmīti.
mn105:6.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho sunakkhatto licchaviputto bhagavato paccassosi.

mn105:8.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco purisapuggalo lokāmisādhimutto assa,
mn105:8.2: lokāmisādhimuttassa kho sunakkhatta, purisapuggalassa tappatirūpī ceva kathā saṇṭhāti, tadanudhammañca anuvitakketi, anuvicāreti, tañca purisaṃ bhajati, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati.
mn105:8.3: āneñjapaṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.
mn105:9.1: seyyathāpi sunakkhatta, puriso sakammā gāmā vā nigamā vā ciravippavuttho assa.
mn105:9.2: so aññataraṃ purisaṃ passeyya tamhā gāmā vā nigamā vā acirapakkantaṃ,
mn105:9.3: so taṃ purisaṃ tassa gāmassa vā nigamassa vā khematañca subhikkhatañca appābādhatañca puccheyya,
mn105:9.4: tassa so puriso tassa gāmassa vā nigamassa vā khematañca subhikkhatañca appābādhatañca saṃseyya.
mn105:9.6: api nu so puriso tassa purisassa sussūseyya, sotaṃ odaheyya, aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeyya, tañca purisaṃ bhajeyya, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjeyyā’ti?
mn105:9.8: evameva kho, sunakkhatta, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati: yaṃ idhekacco purisapuggalo lokāmisādhimutto assa.
mn105:9.9: lokāmisādhimuttassa kho sunakkhatta, purisapuggalassa tappatirūpī ceva kathā saṇṭhāti. tadanudhammañca anuvitakketi, anuvicāreti, tañca purisaṃ bhajati, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati.
mn105:9.10: āneñjapaṭisaññuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti,4 na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.
mn105:9.12: āneñjasaṃyojanena hi kho visaṃyutto lokāmisādhimutto purisapuggaloti.
mn105:10.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ sunakkhatta, vijjati: yaṃ idhekacco purisapuggalo āneñjādhimutto assa,

mn105:11.1: seyyathāpi sunakkhatta, paṇḍupalāso bandhanā pavutto abhabbo haritattāya.
mn105:11.2: evameva kho sunakkhatta, āneñjādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye lokāmisasaññojane se pavutte.
mn105:11.4: lokāmisasaññojanena hi kho visaññutto āneñjādhimutto purisapuggalo’ti.

mn105:12.3: āneñjapaṭisaññuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.

mn105:13.2: evameva kho sunakkhatta, ākiñcaññāyatanādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye āneñjasaññojane se bhinne.
mn105:13.4: āneñjasaññojanena hi kho visaññutto ākiñcaññāyatanādhimutto purisapuggalo’ti.

mn105:14.2: nevasaññānāsaññāyatanādhimuttassa kho sunakkhatta, purisapuggalassa tappatirūpī ceva kathā saṇṭhāti, tadanudhammañca anuvitakketi anuvicāreti, tañca purisaṃ bhajati, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati.
mn105:14.3: ākiñcaññāyatanapaṭisaññuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.
mn105:15.1: seyyathāpi sunakkhatta, puriso manuññabhojanaṃ bhuttāvī chaḍḍeyya.
mn105:15.3: api nu tassa purisassa tasmiṃ bhatte puna bhottukamyatā assā’ti?

mn105:15.9: ākiñcaññāyatanasaññojanena hi kho visaññutto nevasaññānāsaññāyatanādhimutto purisapuggalo’ti.
mn105:16.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati: yaṃ idhekacco purisapuggalo sammānibbānādhimutto assa.
mn105:16.2: sammānibbānādhimuttassa kho sunakkhatta, purisapuggalassa tappatirūpī ceva kathā saṇṭhāti, tadanudhammañca anuvitakketi, anuvicāreti, tañca purisaṃ bhajati, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati,
mn105:16.3: nevasaññānāsaññāyatanapaṭisaññuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.

mn105:17.2: evameva kho sunakkhatta, sammā nibbānādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññojane se ucchinnamūle tālāvatthukate anabhāvakate āyatiṃ anuppādadhamme.
mn105:17.4: ‘nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññojanena hi kho visaññutto sammā nibbānādhimutto purisapuggalo’ti.
mn105:18.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ sunakkhatta, vijjati. yaṃ idhekaccassa bhikkhuno evamassa:
mn105:18.2: ‘taṇhā kho sallaṃ samaṇena vuttaṃ avijjāvisadoso chandarāgabyāpādena ruppati.
mn105:18.3: taṃ me taṇhāsallaṃ pahīnaṃ, apanīto avijjāvisadoso, sammānibbānādhimuttohamasmī’ti.
mn105:18.5: so yāni sammā nibbānādhimuttassa asappāyāni, tāni anuyuñjeyya: asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ anuyuñjeyya.
mn105:18.6: tassa asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ anuyuttassa rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseyya.
mn105:18.7: so rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
mn105:19.1: seyyathāpi sunakkhatta, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷhūpalepanena.
mn105:19.2: tassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ.
mn105:19.3: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto satthena vaṇamukhaṃ parikanteyya.
mn105:19.4: satthena vaṇamukhaṃ parikantetvā esaniyā sallaṃ eseyya.
mn105:19.5: esaniyā sallaṃ esetvā sallaṃ abbaheyya apaneyya visadosaṃ saupādisesaṃ.
mn105:19.7: ‘ambho purisa, ubbhataṃ kho te sallaṃ, apanīto visadoso saupādiseso,
mn105:19.9: sappāyāni ceva bhojanāni bhuñjeyyāsi, mā te asappāyāni bhojanāni bhuñjato vaṇo assāvī assa.
mn105:19.10: kālena kālaṃ vaṇaṃ dhoveyyāsi, kālena ca kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpeyyāsi, mā te na kālena kālaṃ vaṇaṃ dhovato na kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpato pubbalohitaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ pariyonandhi.
mn105:19.11: mā ca vātātape cārittaṃ anuyuñji, mā te vātātape cārittaṃ anuyuttassa rajosūkaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ anuddhaṃsesi,
mn105:19.12: vaṇānurakkhī ca ambho purisa vihareyyāsi vaṇasāropī’ti.
mn105:20.2: ‘ubbhataṃ kho me sallaṃ, apanīto visadoso anupādiseso,
mn105:20.4: so asappāyāni ceva bhojanāni bhuñjeyya. tassa asappāyāni bhojanāni bhuñjato vaṇo assāvī assa.
mn105:20.5: na ca kālena kālaṃ vaṇaṃ dhoveyya. na ca kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpeyya. tassa na kālena kālaṃ vaṇaṃ dhovato, na kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpato pubbalohitaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ pariyonendhayya.
mn105:20.6: vātātape ca cārittaṃ anuyuñjeyya. tassa vātātape cārittaṃ anuyuttassa rajosūkaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ anuddhaṃseyya
mn105:20.7: na ca vaṇānurakkhī vihareyya na vaṇasāropī.
mn105:20.8: tassa imissā ca asappāyakiriyāya, asu ca visadoso apanīto saupādiseso, tadubhayena vaṇo puthuttaṃ gaccheyya.
mn105:20.9: so puthuttaṃ gatena vaṇena maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
mn105:21.1: evameva kho sunakkhatta, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati yaṃ idhekaccassa bhikkhuno evamassa:
mn105:21.2: taṇhā kho sallaṃ samaṇena vuttaṃ, avijjāvisadoso chandarāgabyāpādena ruppati,
mn105:21.3: taṃ me taṇhāsallaṃ pahīnaṃ, apanīto avijjāvisadoso, sammā nibbānādhimuttohami’smī’ti.
mn105:21.5: so yāni sammānibbānādhimuttassa asappāyāni tāni anuyuñjeyya: asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ anuyuñjeyya.
mn105:21.6: tassa asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ anuyuttassa rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseyya.
mn105:21.7: so rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya, maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
mn105:22.1: maraṇaṃ hetaṃ sunakkhatta, ariyassa vinaye yo sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
mn105:22.2: maraṇamattaṃhetaṃ sunakkhatta, dukkhaṃ yo aññataraṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati.
mn105:23.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idhekaccassa bhikkhuno evamassa:
mn105:23.2: ‘taṇhā kho sallaṃ samaṇena vuttaṃ, avijjāvisadoso chandarāgabyāpādena ruppati.
mn105:23.3: taṃ me taṇhāsallaṃ pahīnaṃ apanīto avijjāvisadoso, sammā nibbānādhimuttohamasmī’ti.
mn105:23.4: sammānibbānādhimuttasseva sato. so yāni sammānibbānādhimuttassa asappāyāni, tāni nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ nānuyuñjeyya.
mn105:23.5: tassa asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ nānuyuttassa rāgo cittaṃ nānuddhaṃseyya.
mn105:23.6: so na rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena neva maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya, na maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.

mn105:25.2: ubbhataṃ kho me sallaṃ apanīto visadoso anupādiseso.

mn105:25.5: kālena ca kālaṃ vaṇaṃ dhoveyya, kālena ca kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpeyya, tassa kālena kālaṃ vaṇaṃ dhovato kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpato pubbalohitaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ na pariyonandheyya.
mn105:25.6: na ca vātātape cārittaṃ anuyuñjeyya, tassa vātātape cārittaṃ ananuyuttassa rajosūkaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ nānuddhaṃseyya,
mn105:25.8: tassa imissā ca sappāya kiriyāya asu ca visadoso apanīto anupādiseso. tadubhayena vaṇo virūheyya
mn105:25.9: so rūḷhena vaṇena sañchavinā neva maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya, na maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.

mn105:26.5: tassa asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ nānuyuttassa rāgo cittaṃ nānuddhaṃseyya.
mn105:26.6: so na rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena neva maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya, na maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
mn105:27.1: upamā kho me ayaṃ sunakkhatta, katā atthassa viññāpanāya.
mn105:27.3: vaṇoti kho sunakkhatta, channetaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
mn105:27.7: satthanti kho sunakkhatta, ariyāyetaṃ paññāya adhivacanaṃ.
mn105:27.8: bhisakko sallakattoti kho sunakkhatta, tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
mn105:28.1: so vata sunakkhatta, bhikkhu chasu phassāyatanesu saṃvutakārī.
mn105:28.2: upadhi dukkhassa mūlanti iti viditvā nirupadhi, upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto upadhismiṃ vā kāyaṃ upasaṃharissati cittaṃ vā uppādessatī’ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn105:29.1: seyyathāpi sunakkhatta, āpānīyakaṃso vaṇṇasampanno gandhasampanno rasasampanno,
mn105:29.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikkūlo.
mn105:29.5: api nu so puriso amuṃ āpānīyakaṃsaṃ piveyya. yaṃ jaññā
mn105:29.6: imāhaṃ pivitvā maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi, maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkha’nti?
mn105:29.8: evameva kho sunakkhatta, so vata bhikkhu chasu phassāyatanesu saṃvutakārī
mn105:29.9: upadhi dukkhassa mūlanti iti viditvā nirupadhi, upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto upadhismiṃ vā kāyaṃ upasaṃharissati, cittaṃ vā uppādessatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn105:30.2: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikkūlo.
mn105:30.4: api nu so puriso amussa āsīvisassa ghoravisassa hatthaṃ vā aṅguṭṭhaṃ vā yuñjeyya yaṃ jaññā
mn105:30.5: imināhaṃ daṭṭho maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi, maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkha’nti?
mn105:30.7: evameva kho sunakkhatta, so vata bhikkhu chasu phassāyatanesu saṃvutakārī,
mn105:30.8: upadhi dukkhassa mūlanti iti viditvā nirupadhi, upadhi saṅkhaye vimutto upadhismiṃ vā kāyaṃ upasaṃharissati, cittaṃ vā uppādessatī’ti
mn105:30.11: attamano sunakkhatto licchaviputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandī’ti.
